description: A switch passing one of eight rows of three inputs to three outputs, with the row chosen by a trigger on its own row

params.text: Selects that row by hand, and lights while that row is the selected one

inputs.text: A rising edge selects that row, so its three inputs are the ones passed to the outputs
One of the three signals passed on while its row is the selected one

outputs.text: Carries the input from its own column of the selected row, or 0V when that jack is unpatched
